name: Why is properly maintained exterior trim important for my home?

mainEntity.name: Why is properly maintained exterior trim important for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Properly maintained exterior trim serves several critical functions for your home. It protects the underlying structure from moisture intrusion, preventing rot, mold, and pest infestations. Trim also plays a significant role in your home's aesthetic appeal, contributing to its curb appeal and overall value. Neglecting trim maintenance can lead to more extensive and costly structural damage over time. Regular upkeep ensures your home remains protected, attractive, and maintains its structural integrity, a key factor in property preservation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintained trim protects against moisture and pests, enhances curb appeal, and prevents costly structural damage.
